about.title: About Our Firm
about.content: Technodeals BD is a multidisciplinary consultancy firm providing integrated, end-to-end solutions. By combining innovative thinking with engineering precision, we transform complex challenges into sustainable successes.

services.title: Consultancy
services.desc: Expert technical and strategic maritime advice.

products.title: 50T 8Point Mooring Winch
products.desc: Heavy-duty eight-point mooring spread for offshore positioning and station-keeping. Multi-drum arrangement for simultaneous line make-up, tension monitoring, and controlled release during berthing or field operations.

products.title: 60 Ton Storage Winch
products.desc: High-capacity storage winch for long lengths of wire or synthetic rope. Suited to deck stowage, cable laying support, and controlled payout / recovery in industrial and marine applications.

products.title: 40 Ton 4 Point Mooring Winch
products.desc: Four-point mooring winch system for terminals, barges, and offshore spreads. Delivers reliable line pull for symmetric mooring layouts and coordinated tensioning.

products.title: 10 Ton Single Drum Lifting Winch
products.desc: Single-drum lifting winch for deck stores, workshop lifts, and auxiliary hoisting. Compact configuration for batch production or vessel retrofit programmes.
products.image: media/10 Ton Single Drum Lifting Winch.png

products.title: 50 Ton Anchor Handling Towing Winch
products.desc: Anchor-handling and towing (AHTS) winch rated for high line pull, braking, and spooling of wire and chain during rig moves, buoy work, and offshore support.
products.image: media/50 Ton Anchor Handling Towing Winch.png

products.title: 3 Ton Double Drum Anchor Windlass
products.desc: Double-drum anchor windlass for chain and rope handling on foredecks and workboats. Separated drums allow independent anchor work while maintaining a small installed footprint.
products.image: media/3 Ton Double Drum Anchor Windlass.png

products.title: 250 Ton Single Drum Hydraulic Mooring Winch
products.desc: A 250-ton capacity hydraulic mooring winch system used for laying submersible pipeline. In 2013, it laid 37km of 24-inch diameter pipeline at 52m depth, pulling 3.2km onshore in Surabaya, Indonesia.
products.image: media/250 Ton Single Drum Hydraulic Mooring Winch.png

products.title: Marine Terminal Gangway & Pontoon
products.desc: Delivered in 2021, this system includes a pair of pontoons (9m x 5m x 1.8m) with gangways (12m long x 2m wide) to improve workflow between two facility parts.

products.title: 2.5 Ton 3m Marinized Sub-zero Cold Storage Electrical Overhead 4-way Slewring Crane
products.desc: 9 units delivered in 2021 for Antarctic krill fishing vessels. Operates in Zone 1 hazardous areas and cold storage (-32°C), powered by vessel electrical systems.
products.image: media/2.5Ton 3m Marinized Sub-zero Cold Storage Electrical Overhead 4-way Slewing Crane.png

products.title: 100 Ton Turret Gantry Hoist
products.desc: Manufactured for FPSO vessel in 2015. Features mono-railing 100-ton vertical lifting with ±50mm longitude accuracy. Lifting speed: 0.7m/min (low) / 7m/min (high), lifting height 53m, traveling speed 3m/min.

products.title: Pipeline End Manifolds (PLEMs)
products.desc: Subsea pipeline termination structures that split pipeline flow into branches connected to production/injection wells. Includes engineering, procurement, and installation with considerations for soil conditions, thermal expansion, and flow-induced vibrations.

products.title: API Wellhead & X-Mas Tree
products.desc: Sales of oil & gas wellhead equipment including casing head, casing head spool, tubing head spool, API X-mas tree, choke & kill manifold, manual/hydraulic gate valves, and check valves.

products.title: API Rotating Blowout Preventer (RBOP) & Mud/Gas Separator
products.desc: Safety equipment for oil & gas drilling operations including rotating blowout preventers and mud/gas separators.

products.title: API Flanges, Drilling Spool, Elbows & Hammer Union
products.desc: Various sizes of API flanges, drilling spools, API elbows, hammer unions, ring gaskets, studs, bolts, and nuts.

products.title: NOV (Varco) TDS-8S Topdrive Bearings Assembly Complete
products.desc: Completed overhaul service for TDS-8S Topdrive in the Netherlands in 2022. Provides inspections, repair, and servicing for both old and new top drives.

products.title: Marine & Offshore Machineries Repair
products.desc: Service and repair for brands including Plimsoll, PH Hydraulics, Promoter, Transvictory, MacGregor, Rolls Royce.

products.title: Marine & Offshore Cranes Repair (JJ, MacGregor)
products.desc: Specialized repair services for JJ and MacGregor marine and offshore cranes.

products.title: Hopper Hydraulic Cylinders Repair (Bosch Rexroth)
products.desc: Overhaul and repair services for Bosch Rexroth hopper hydraulic cylinders.

products.title: Lars System Repair (Deeptech)
products.desc: Refurbishment and repair services for Deeptech LARS (Launch and Recovery System).

products.title: Pipe Handling System Repair (TC, JJ)
products.desc: Repair and servicing of pipe handling systems from TC and JJ.

products.title: 30Ton Bow Towing Winch Repair
products.desc: On-site repair of 30-ton bow towing winch in Cameroon.

products.title: 10Ton Single Drum Lifting Winch Servicing & Commissioning
products.desc: Servicing and commissioning completed in Indonesia.
products.image: media/10 Ton Single Drum Lifting Winch.png

products.title: Refurbishment of LARS System
products.desc: Complete refurbishment of Launch and Recovery Systems at TC Workshop.

products.title: 1Ton-10M / 3Ton-4.8M Electrical Hydraulic Knuckle Boom Crane
products.desc: Electrical hydraulic knuckle boom crane available in 1-ton (10m) and 3-ton (4.8m) configurations.

products.title: Overhaul of Hopper Cylinder
products.desc: Complete hopper cylinder overhaul service at TC Workshop.

products.title: 0.5Ton 20M Cargo Crane Electro-Hydraulic
products.desc: Electro-hydraulic cargo crane with 0.5-ton capacity and 20-meter reach.

products.title: 1.2Ton 11.5m Marine Crane
products.desc: Marine crane with 1.2-ton lifting capacity and 11.5-meter length.

projects.title: 72m Offshore Support Vessel
projects.desc: Concept design, stability analysis, and class approval for a DP-2 offshore support vessel operating in harsh environments.

projects.title: High-Speed Aluminum Catamaran
projects.desc: Hydrodynamic optimization and resistance analysis resulting in a 12% reduction in fuel consumption.

projects.title: Multi-Purpose Harbor Tug
projects.desc: Full design package including intact/damage stability, class drawings, and flag-state approval.
